pcb.title:
Certified PCB Assembly Manufacturer
for Surveillance & Automation Brands
pcb.description: At Adiance Technologies, we bring together decades of experience and deep specialization in camera and robotics PCBAs. With advanced in-house SMT and THT lines, strict IPC compliance, and full traceability, we ensure every board is reliable, scalable and export-ready.
pcb.mapImageAlt: Global presence map showing PCB manufacturing reach

leftFeatures.title: 20+ Years of Manufacturing Expertise
leftFeatures.description: We've been manufacturing PCBs and assemblies for critical industries like surveillance and robotics, trusted by Indian and global brands alike.

leftFeatures.title: Specialization in Camera & Robotics PCBAs
leftFeatures.description: From high-frequency signal boards to AI-ready motor control units — we manufacture printed circuit boards engineered for real-world deployment.

leftFeatures.title: In-House Assembly Infrastructure
leftFeatures.description: Our SMT and through-hole lines handle complex layouts with high component density and support multi-layer PCBs (2–12+ layers).

leftFeatures.title: IPC-A-610 Class 2 & 3 Compliance
leftFeatures.description: Every PCB assembly meets international standards for commercial and mission-critical applications, verified with detailed testing and documentation.

leftFeatures.title: End-to-End Traceability
leftFeatures.description: From BOM validation to serialized QR/barcode tagging, every board is trackable—critical for regulated and export-grade products.

leftFeatures.title: Pre-Tested & Documentation-Ready Assemblies
leftFeatures.description: Each PCB is tested for functional integrity and shipped with detailed inspection reports, firmware records and compliance documentation.

leftFeatures.title: White-Label & OEM Friendly
leftFeatures.description: We support white-label PCB services with secure branding, private documentation and tamper-proof packaging—ideal for OEM clients and tech brands.

bottomFeatures.title: Export-Ready PCB Manufacturer in India
bottomFeatures.description: We comply with CE, RoHS, FCC, NDAA, and other global standards—serving Indian and international brands looking for scalable pcb design and manufacturing.
